message: You know that one friend who always panics at the slightest hint of danger? Yep, that's my buddy Jake. Last week, he practically leaped out of his skin when my smoke alarm chirped—turns out it just needed a new battery! 😂 It got me thinking about how easy it is to overlook our fire safety plans. I had to check in with my own smoke alarms and refresh my escape plan. It’s a simple reminder that a little preparedness can go a long way in keeping calm. Do you have a fire drill plan with your family?
